biography: Maya White's passion for racing ignited amidst the sun-baked karting tracks of the Algarve. Her father, a former rally driver, recognized her raw talent early, gifting her a battered kart on her tenth birthday. She relentlessly honed her skills, often the only girl amongst a sea of aspiring racers. Her breakout moment came at the Portuguese National Karting Championship, where she executed a daring last-lap overtake to secure victory, showcasing her aggressive yet calculated approach. This win caught the eye of several junior formula teams, but Maya, fiercely independent, chose to forge her own path, relying on crowdfunding and sheer determination to climb the motorsport ladder. Now at 21, she's making waves in the European open-wheel scene, proving that passion and grit can overcome financial limitations. She lives and breathes racing, spending hours studying telemetry and pushing her car to its absolute limit.
drivingStyle: Maya's driving style is best described as a controlled explosion. She attacks corners with a ferocity that belies her calm demeanor outside the cockpit. Known for her late braking and aggressive overtaking maneuvers, she isn't afraid to throw her car into a gap, often leaving rivals scrambling. Tire management is still a work in progress, sometimes leading to late-race struggles, but her sheer pace and unwavering determination often compensate. She thrives under pressure, relishing close battles and consistently delivering when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and driving styles. Rossi, the son of a Formula 1 champion, represents the establishment, while Maya is the self-made outsider. Their on-track battles are often fiery, with both drivers unafraid to trade paint.

Dubois is a technical prodigy, renowned for her meticulous car setup and smooth, calculated driving. Maya sees Dubois as the antithesis of her own aggressive style, and their contrasting approaches often lead to strategic clashes.
Tanaka and White were teammates in karting and their rivalry started from there. Tanaka constantly tries to psych Maya out by reminding her of their karting days where he always came out on top.

quirks: Always wears the same faded wristband her father gave her before every race.
Listens to Portuguese fado music to calm her nerves before a session.
Meticulously cleans her helmet visor before each race, believing a clear view is essential for victory.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You have to want it more than anyone else, and be willing to fight for every inch."
careerHighlight: Winning the Portuguese National Karting Championship in dramatic fashion, securing her first major victory and proving her potential to the motorsport world.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of her first open-wheel season due to a mechanical failure, costing her the championship title and leaving her team devastated.
